Package CPDFGeneration

Class CEmailAttachment

java.lang.Object
CPDFGeneration.CEmailAttachment
public final class CEmailAttachment extends Object
Owned Java snapshot of an attachment, valid after its result is closed. Metadata-only attachments have hasData set to false and getData() returns null; this differs from a valid empty attachment. Attachment bytes are copied into Java memory when this snapshot is obtained.
Since:
1.3.0
